name: cpu_exhaustion
description: Diagnostic workflow for high CPU load, CPU spikes, CPU faults, and thread saturation.

steps.goal: Inspect CPU utilization and run-queue metrics across candidate components.
Identify the earliest sustained CPU elevation (>= 3 samples) exceeding baseline.
Verify whether high CPU is an independent root cause or a symptom of I/O wait.
Check logs and downstream trace latency to confirm impact propagation.

rules: High CPU can be a downstream symptom of thread locking or I/O waits.
Node-level CPU load impacts all co-located pods; isolate node vs container level.
Require persistent onset (> 2 minutes) rather than an isolated transient spike.
